# Valid key names in a REAPER .ReaperTheme [color theme] section.
#
# Taken from a real, published theme (Flat Madness Dark, gapalil001/FlatMadness,
# Sources/Flat Madness Dark.ReaperTheme/Flat_madness_Dark_edition_EDIT.ReaperTheme,
# 359 keys). REAPER silently ignores keys it does not know, so a generator that
# invents names produces a file that loads but changes nothing. Anything written
# by tools/gen_theme* or SGM_reaper_ultra_hd_smart_tools.lua must appear here.
#
# Values in that file are 32-bit signed decimal integers, not hex:
#   col_cursor=895743   (0x000DAAFF)
#   col_tl_bg=2302755   (0x00232323)
#   col_main_bg=-2143207103  (0x80414141 - the high bit is alpha)
